negatives.failure_signature: The JavaScript orchestration parser rejected a PowerShell rewrite command because PowerShell backtick-newline tokens terminated the outer template literal.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parser failure and changed to an apply-patch block deletion without layered command-language newline escapes.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not embed PowerShell backtick escapes in a JavaScript template literal; use apply-patch or a single-language file transformation.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the failed orchestration script made no shell call and changed no file

negatives.surface: combined login-shell inspection and compilation probe
negatives.failure: The combined probe reached its 20-second bound before returning any complete child output.
negatives.impact: No file or repository conclusion was drawn from the timed-out parent command.
negatives.workaround: Repeat only the required surfaces as non-login commands with independent bounds; the file-presence and compilation probes then completed.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine shell startup, filesystem enumeration, Git status, and compilation under one short parent envelope on this checkout.
negatives.rollback: Retain the timeout, treat the combined receipt as no evidence, and make no mutation before the bounded retries complete.
negatives.sibling_recommendation: Use independently bounded non-login probes for this checkout when the combined startup surface has already timed out.

retention_rule: Recovery never erases a failure; later evidence may reference only the corrected complete operation.
